title: fix(types,plugin-form,plugin-detail): field metadata members FieldSchema refuses retire as never, and their readers follow the spec keys (objectui#12242)
body:
Part of #12242
Clause-②: yes

The family close-out for "an exported `*FieldMetadata` type declares a member `@objectstack/spec`'s `FieldSchema` refuses". I measured every member of every exported field metadata interface against the installed spec, then gave each refused member one verdict. Each member that can retire now retires on `field-types.ts`'s own `?: never` convention, the one `GridFieldMetadata` uses for `min_rows`. Two type values become the spec's `FieldType` spellings. Readers move to the spec keys, and the docs pages teach the spec's spellings. Members that a live widget reads, that have no field-level spec twin, and whose removal would drop a working capability are **kept** and reported for a decision, as the dispatch's stop condition requires.

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/types`** (`field-types.ts`):
  - `BaseFieldMetadata.visible_on` becomes a `never` tombstone. `visibleWhen` is declared by reference to `FieldSchema.visibleWhen`.
  - `CurrencyFieldMetadata.currency` becomes a `never` tombstone. `currencyConfig` is declared by reference.
  - These retire as `never` with no replacement key, because the spec has no twin and nothing reads them: `filterable`, `min_date` / `max_date` (on both date types), `default_zoom`, `starting_number`, `schema` and `normalize`.
  - `AutoNumberFieldMetadata.type` changes `'auto_number'` → `'autonumber'`. `ObjectFieldMetadata.type` changes `'object'` → `'json'`.
  - `VisibilityCondition` is marked `@deprecated`, since no member declares it any more.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-form`**: `ObjectForm`'s object-field builder and the sectioned forms' name-string entries stop reading `visible_on`. Both already carried `visibleWhen`.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-detail`** (**p2 position**, outside the claim's listed file surface, named here per the dispatch): `RecordDetailPanel`'s field build and `RelatedList`'s cell bag forwarded the retiring `currency` and dropped `currencyConfig`. On those two surfaces, a spec field declaring `currencyConfig: { currencyMode: 'fixed', defaultCurrency: 'EUR' }` read as a bare number. Measured red before the change: `RelatedList` cells `["Tower","1,234.50","6,789.50"]`, with no `€`. Both sites now forward `currencyConfig`. They are readers of the retiring member, which is why they move in this change (E3 (b) / E6).
- **Docs**: `date`, `datetime`, `location`, `vector`, `currency`, `auto-number` and `object` under `content/docs/fields/` teach the spec's spellings. `object.mdx` now teaches the object-level `json_schema` validation rule in place of the field-level `schema`. It also no longer claims that the authored `schema` "is carried on the field metadata untouched" to the server: the spec refuses that key at publish.
- **`scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs`** (fixture triage, outside the listed file surface): the two pages' entries in that gate's per-file type ledger follow the new values (`autonumber`, `json`, `json_schema`). The old `auto_number`, `string` and `boolean` entries had gone stale.
- **Fixture triage**: in `summaryChip.displayLocale-9453.test.tsx`, the EUR field cast to `FieldMetadata` is re-spelled as `currencyConfig`, which is what failed `plugin-detail` `type-check`. In `sectionFields.blankGate-11262.test.ts`, the `visible_on` chain row pinned the branch this change deletes. It is replaced by a load-bearing block: a predicate under `visible_on` is not carried and is not reported, and the same predicate under `visibleOn` still is (control).

## E2: what reads `GRID_FIELD_RETIRED_KEYS`

Two runtime **refusals** read it, and no alias does: `GridField` draws a named refusal instead of the grid, and the `FormFieldSchema` zod mirror carries an `aliasKeyRefusal` arm per entry. No reader accepts a snake key through it.

⚠️ This change follows the `?: never` member shape and its docblock mapping: each tombstone's `@deprecated` line names the key to write. It adds **no new exported map constant**. The grid map exists for those two runtime consumers, and this family has none. Only two of its retired members (`visible_on`, `currency`) even have a twin to map to. A constant with zero readers would be a new unpulled public export. The seat decides whether that matches the triage ruling's "mapped to its camelCase key". It is listed under open questions in the report.

## Census (installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0, objectui `main` `923504f`)

Method: `FieldSchema.safeParse` on a minimal field of the interface's own type, carrying the member. A type that is not a spec `FieldType` was probed on the nearest spec type: `autonumber`, `json`, `location`, `master_detail`. Readers come from a non-test `git grep` of each spelling in `packages/*/src`. This table is a reading taken once. The retired rows are re-derived on every run by `field-metadata-family-retired-12242.test.ts`, and nothing re-derives the kept rows.

| Interface | Member / value | `FieldSchema` | Spec twin | Non-test readers | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Base | `visible_on` | `unrecognized_keys`, hint → `visibleWhen` | `visibleWhen` (CEL) | `ObjectForm`, `sectionFields`. Both already read `visibleWhen` too | **(a)** retired → `visibleWhen`, declared by reference; both snake reads removed |
| Base | `filterable` | `unrecognized_keys` | none | none (the `filterable` hits are `RelatedList` / `ActivityTimeline` component props) | **(c)** retired, no target |
| Base | `mobile_fullscreen` | `unrecognized_keys` | none | `TextAreaField`, `RichTextField`, the form renderer; produced by `ObjectForm` | **kept**: stop condition |
| Base | `validate` | `unrecognized_keys` | none at field level | `buildValidationRules` | **kept**: stop condition |
| Text | `pattern`, `pattern_message` | `unrecognized_keys` | object level only: `validations[]` `{ type: 'format', field, regex, message }` | `buildValidationRules` (field level only) | **kept**: needs decision (cross-level twin; no live client reads the object rule) |
| Currency | `currency` | `unrecognized_keys` | `currencyConfig` (`fixed` + `defaultCurrency`) | `resolveFieldCurrency` reads both; `RecordDetailPanel` / `RelatedList` forwarded only `currency` (**p2**) | **(a)** retired → `currencyConfig`, declared by reference; the two forwarders now carry it |
| Date, DateTime | `min_date`, `max_date` | `unrecognized_keys` | none (`min` / `max` are numbers) | none | **(c)** retired, no target |
| Date, DateTime | `dueLike` | `unrecognized_keys` | none | the date/datetime cell renderers; also `DetailViewFieldSchema.dueLike` | **kept**: stop condition |
| Location | `default_zoom` | `unrecognized_keys` | none | none | **(c)** retired, no target |
| Lookup | `idField` | `unrecognized_keys` | none | `LookupField`, `GridField` lookup cells | **kept**: stop condition |
| Lookup | `reference_field` | `unrecognized_keys`, hint → `referenceVia` | n/a | n/a | out of scope (objectui#12157) |
| AutoNumber | type `auto_number` | `invalid_value` at `type` | `autonumber` | widget key `field:auto_number`; `mapFieldTypeToFormType` maps both spellings | type value → `autonumber` |
| AutoNumber | `starting_number` | `unrecognized_keys` | none | none | **(c)** retired, no target |
| User | `picker`, `subtitle` | `unrecognized_keys` | none | `LookupField`, `UserField` | **kept**: stop condition |
| User | `avatar_field` | `unrecognized_keys` | n/a | n/a | out of scope (objectui#12157) |
| Object | type `object` | `invalid_value` at `type` | `json` | `json` and `object` both resolve to `field:object` | type value → `json` |
| Object | `schema` | `unrecognized_keys` | object level: `validations[]` `{ type: 'json_schema', field, schema }` | none (`ObjectField` checks syntax only) | **(c)** retired; docs teach the object rule |
| Vector | `normalize` | `unrecognized_keys` | none | none (`VectorField` reads `dimensions` only) | **(c)** retired, no target |
| Geolocation | type `geolocation` | `invalid_value` at `type` | none (`location` is a different widget) | `GeolocationField` | **kept**: stop condition |
| Grid | type `grid` and its members | `invalid_value` at `type`; members refused on `master_detail` | n/a | `GridField` | out of scope: objectui's own field type, keys ruled by objectui#11610 / objectui#11070 |

**Accepted by the spec, no action**:

- Base: `name`, `label`, `type`, `inlineHelpText`, `description`, `required`, `readonly`, `system`, `placeholder`, `defaultValue`, `sortable`, `dependsOn`, `unique`.
- Text-family `minLength` / `maxLength`.
- `rows` on textarea / markdown / html / richtext.
- Number `min`, `max`, `precision`, `scale`, `step`, `useGrouping`.
- Currency `precision`, `min`, `max`.
- Percent `precision`, `scale`, `min`, `max`.
- `format` on date / datetime / time / phone / autonumber.
- Select `options`, `multiple`, `searchable`.
- File / image `multiple`, `accept`, `maxSize`.
- Lookup `reference`, `multiple`, `searchable`, `options`, `displayField`, `allowCreate`, `descriptionField`, `lookupColumns`, `lookupPageSize`, `lookupFilters`.
- Formula `expression`, `returnType`. Summary `summaryOperations`.
- User `multiple`, `lookupFilters`.
- Vector `dimensions`.
- Slider `min`, `max`, `step`. Rating `max`. Master-detail `reference`.
- Boolean, color, code, avatar, signature, qrcode and address: type value only, and each is a spec `FieldType`.

Not field documents, so not censused: `SelectOptionMetadata` (the option face, ruled under objectui#6153 / objectui#7014), `LookupColumnDef` / `LookupFilterDef` (nested in accepted keys), and `UploadedFileMetadata` (a field VALUE payload).

## Tests (run on `00f58c4` unless noted)

- `field-metadata-family-retired-12242.test.ts` (`@object-ui/types`). One pin per member: a fresh annotated literal carrying the retired key is refused (`@ts-expect-error`), the two spec twins are declared by reference and compile, both type values go both ways, and the installed spec's own answer is checked for each, behind an accepting control.
- `ObjectForm.visibleWhen-12242.test.tsx` (`@object-ui/plugin-form`). Through the real `ObjectForm`: `visibleWhen` hides the field until the record satisfies the predicate (the live control), and the same predicate under `visible_on` gates nothing.
- `currencyConfigRelay-12242.test.tsx` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`). The fixed-EUR amount reaches `DetailSection`, `RecordDetailPanel` and `RelatedList`, beside a no-currency control. It was red before the fix on exactly the panel and the related list.
- Ablations, each committed first, mutated via `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit and blob change verified on disk), and restored to `blob == HEAD` with an empty `git diff HEAD`:
  - Putting `ObjectForm`'s `visible_on` read back turns its pin red (`visible_on is no gate: the field is drawn: expected null not to be null`).
  - Putting `sectionFields`' `visible_on ??` back turns 5 rows red.
  - Un-retiring `currency` (`?: never` → `?: string`) turns `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` red (`TS2578: Unused '@ts-expect-error' directive` at the `_currency` row).
  - One ablation **stayed green**, and this change was dropped because of it. A first draft also moved `ObjectForm`'s computed-type gate from `'auto_number'` to `'autonumber'`. Restoring `'auto_number'` left its pin green: the auto-number widget is display-only, and `sanitize.ts` strips both spellings, so the `disabled` flag changes nothing a person sees. That edit and its vacuous pin were removed. The position is under Acceptance notes.

Results at `00f58c4`, all from the repo root under the verify lock:

- `pnpm exec vitest run` per package, each exit 0:
  - `packages/types/`: 373 files, 10217 tests passed.
  - `packages/plugin-form/`: 180 files; 2200 passed, 1 skipped.
  - `packages/fields/`: 250 files (249 passed, 1 skipped); 4019 tests passed, 7 skipped.
  - `scripts/__tests__/`: 183 files (181 passed, 2 skipped); 5541 tests passed, 2 skipped.
  - The nine tests outside `scripts/` that name `check-doc-component-types` (which this change edits): 9 files, 708 tests passed.
- `packages/plugin-detail/`: exit 1, with one test timing out: `record-details.hideFieldsUncast-9965` ("resolved the mirror"), 34s against its 15s budget, mid-suite on a shared box. Run alone on the same HEAD it passes 10/10 in 7s; the other 260 files passed. This reads as load, not a verdict.
- `type-check`, after the dependency-closure build: `@object-ui/types`, `fields`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-detail` and `plugin-grid`, each exit 0, with the script name echoed. `plugin-detail` was red once, on the `summaryChip` fixture, before that fixture was re-spelled.
- Green gates:
  - `check:doc-types`: "Every documented component type is registered".
  - `check:doc-json`.
  - `check:designer-field-key-parity`: OK.
  - `check:spec-symbols`.
  - `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new.
  - `check:control-bytes`: OK.
  - `changeset:check`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:changeset-claims`.
  - `check-doc-links`, `check-doc-example-ids`, `check-doc-fence-languages`.
  - Governed-surface `--test`: NOT GOVERNED.
- **NOT MEASURED locally:**
  - `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples` exit 2 (could not run): they need the whole package set built, and CI builds it. A narrowed measurement stands in. Every `ts` block of the seven touched pages (14 snippets) compiles `--strict` against the freshly built `@object-ui/types` / `@object-ui/fields` `dist/`. A planted control carrying `min_date` on a `DateFieldMetadata` fails with TS2322, so the harness can fail.
  - `check:readme-exports` could not judge 407 self-imports on the unbuilt tree. This change touches no README and no export.

## The seat's disposition

The census found members the stop condition keeps, so they are not retired here: `mobile_fullscreen`, `validate`, `pattern` / `pattern_message`, `dueLike`, `idField`, `picker` / `subtitle`, and the `geolocation` type value. The seat switched the first line from `Fixes` to `Part of`, so objectui#12242 stays open as the anchor for those positions. Their disposition is recorded on the card. The merge of this PR decides none of them.

## Acceptance notes (observed, not filed)

- `sectionFields`' name-string chain still reads the object schema's `visibleOn`. The spec refuses that key too ("did you mean `visibleOn` → `visibleWhen`?"), so it is a read of a key no published object can carry. It is not a census member and is left as it is.
- `resolveFieldCurrency` (`@object-ui/i18n`) reads a field-level `currency` before `currencyConfig`. That is a second spelling for field metadata, but the resolver is shared with presentation surfaces where `currency` is a spec key. It is reported, not extended, and not changed here.
- app-shell `RecordDetailView`'s section build forwards `currency` without `currencyConfig`. I did not measure whether `DetailSection`'s enrichment from the object schema puts it back on the record page.
- `ObjectForm`'s computed-type gate still compares `auto_number`. It is inert for the display-only widget, as the ablation above shows.
- `auto-number.mdx` teaches a `{Q}` (quarter) token. The spec's `parseAutonumberFormat` reads `{Q}` as a FIELD interpolation, so the page's own example `{YY}Q{Q}-{000}` renders `24Q-001` (measured with the spec's `renderAutonumber`), not `24Q1-001`. That is a different defect class from this card, and it goes to the report for the seat.
